name: Dodoma
subtitle: Dodoma, capital of Tanzania: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 765,179 people live in Dodoma City (counted 2022).
Before the 20th century the site held a small settlement of some Gogo clans; by 1907 the Germans had built a central railroad there.
Dodoma became the capital after a 1973 decision to move the seat from Dar es Salaam; its central location and more comfortable climate drew officials.

parts.text: Before the 20th century the site held a small settlement of some Gogo clans; by 1907 the Germans had built a central railroad there.
Dodoma became the capital after a 1973 decision to move the seat from Dar es Salaam; its central location and more comfortable climate drew officials.
The 1973 plan, approved by the party conference, expected a ten-year move but it took roughly fifty years; real progress came under President Magufuli.
Dodoma is the political and administrative capital; Dar es Salaam remains the economic and cultural hub.
Moving the capital was argued to be more economically viable than restructuring Dar es Salaam.

blocks.prompt: About how many people do you think live in Dodoma City?

parts.text: 765,179 in 2022, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Dodoma City, 2022 Population and Housing Census (held 23 Aug to 4 Sep 2022, NBS).

items.text: Germans had built a central railroad through Dodoma.
A Legislative Council debate judged Dodoma ideal for the capital, but the idea was shelved over cost.
TANU decided on full relocation to Dodoma within 10 years (declared August 1973; conference approval October 1973).
Parliament moved to Dodoma, but the transfer stalled for lack of offices.
President Magufuli ordered a full, immediate move to Dodoma.
Early 2020: Job Ndugai Market officially began operations.
New State House at Chamwino, Dodoma inaugurated.
